fieldValues.title: No Protocol had been run before a minutes process needed one
fieldValues.summary: No repository in the programme held a protocol run until 2026-11-27, and the spec defines no run; a standing ruling left run semantics to be designed when a consumer needed them, and named a decision log as that consumer.
evidence: Survey 2026-11-27: no runs/runs.json under semanticops or muSrs; seven distinct Protocol definitions, none using outputType
rfc-decision-4f1e12e5: run semantics "designed at consumer time"
The only runs: the minutes experiments of 2026-11-27
fieldValues.body: Minutes are the first consumer. The design of the run should come from what they needed: what each stage produced, who ran it, which checks passed, and travel with the document.
